messages:
deploy-bot: deploy finished for release v2.14.0 to canary (usw2, eu1, apac2). post-deploy smoke started. overall: 18/20 probes passed, 2 failing in eu1 (embed route p95 and kv-prefill heartbeat). attaching quick logs.

olivia: seeing p95 jump to ~420ms on eu1 embed route right after warmup. throughput looks stable. no 5xxs in prod but the synth probe keeps timing out (~3s).

matt: added context — those two failing synthes are the short-prompt bucket + prefill probe. wondered if quantized variant on eu1 is regressing.

jin: can we check tokenizer differences? last rollout touched tokenization alias mapping for the embed path. might be mismatch between model variant and tokenizer asset.

sre-bot: alert: eu1-synth-embed p95 > 400ms for 5 consecutive samples (id: a3f9). recent kube restarts: node-3a restarted 1768001129 due to OOM killer, but pods rescheduled.

olivia: noted node restart. but the warm cache should be backfilled — p95 spike seems correlated with prefill failures. suspect cache warmup race.

matt: proposal: pin routing in eu1 for the embed route to previous model variant v2.13.9 while we triage. quick command: `deployctl pin --region eu1 --route /embed --version v2.13.9`

jin: +1 to pin. alternative is immediate rollback of the whole canary but that is noisy. pinning route isolates impact.

tara: tagging release window: change window still open for 30m. if pin takes too long, we'll escalate to rollback.

release-captain: decision? we need to minimize blast radius and preserve telemetry for the other regions. prefer pin for embed route in eu1 now.

matt: i'm on it. running the pin now and will watch synth.

[~30s later]

matt: ran `deployctl pin --region eu1 --route /embed --version v2.13.9` -> started. response: 202 accepted.

sre-bot: routing update: traffic split for eu1 /embed -> 90% v2.13.9, 10% v2.14.0 applied at 1768001218.

olivia: synth probes re-run: embed p95 down to 120ms on first sample. prefill heartbeat still flaky but improved.

jin: will open an issue to track tokenizer/variant mismatch: GH #infra/3482. assigning to jin + infra-ml for follow-up.

release-captain: update release notes draft: include note about eu1 embed route temporary pin due to synth p95 spike. add rollback instructions and pin rationale.

tara: who owns rollback if pin doesn't stabilize? matt/jin?

matt: i'll coordinate pin + rollback. jin owns the hotfix patch.

deploy-bot: post-deploy summary updated: eu1 embed pinned to v2.13.9 at 1768001218. 2 failing probes now resolved per synth (embed p95, prefill). overall status: degraded -> partially mitigated.

olivia: moving canary hold flag on eu1 for full traffic until we confirm stable for 2h. setting note on the deploy ticket.

release-captain: good call. update on rollout checklist: 1) pin applied, 2) owners assigned, 3) release notes updated, 4) hold window set. reconvene if any 5xxs or p95 > 350ms.

matt: logging follow-up steps and will attach perf graphs. ping me if it resurfaces. :thumbsup:

jin: starting tokenizer diff investigation now. will post link to repro in the thread.

deploy-bot: closure note: monitor until 1768004911 (2h). will auto-unflag hold if no regressions.
